result.topic_en: Calculations on a retarded-potential–type integral (with velocity of light c) for a moving charge/density distribution, its Laplacian and variation, a continuity equation, and the transformation of the Laplace operator and related expressions into cylindrical coordinates (r, φ).
result.transcription:
$\delta\int\left[(v+w)\left(\frac{cc}{vw}-\left(\frac{\partial r}{\partial s}\right)^2\right)\frac{\partial s}{r}+2\partial\frac{\frac{\partial r}{\partial s}\,\delta r\,(v+w)}{r}\right]$
$u^{(x+a,y+b,z+c)}=\int\varrho\,dx\,dy\,dz\,\frac{\delta r}{rr}\left(1-\frac{1}{cc}\left(\frac{\partial r}{\partial t}\right)^2+\frac{2r}{cc}\frac{\partial^2 r}{\partial t^2}\right)=\int\varrho\,dx\,dy\,dz\left(-\delta\frac{1}{r}+\delta\frac{1}{r^3}\cdot\frac{[(x'-a')(x-a)\ldots]^2}{cc}-2\delta\frac{1}{r}[?]\frac{1}{cc}((x-a)(x''-a'')\ldots+(x'-a')^2\ldots)\right)$
[-$-\frac{1}{4\pi}(\partial_x^2+\partial_y^2+\partial_z^2)^2u=(\partial_x^2+\partial_y^2+\partial_z^2)\Big[\ldots\frac{1}{3cc}\varrho((x'-a')^2+(y'-b')^2+(z'-c')^2)+\frac{2}{3cc}(\partial_x(x'-a')+\partial_y(y'-b')\ldots)\varrho(\delta x(x'-a')\ldots)-\frac{2}{cc}\varrho(\ldots)\Big]$-]
[-$+\delta\left[-\frac{2}{3cc}(\partial_x(x'-a')+\partial_y(y'-b')\ldots)^2\varrho+\frac{4}{cc}(\partial_x(x''-a'')\ldots)\varrho\right]$-]
$-\frac{1}{4\pi}(\partial_x^2+\partial_y^2+\partial_z^2)u=(\partial_x^2+\partial_y^2+\partial_z^2)\Big[\delta\varrho+\frac{2}{cc}(\partial_x(x'-a')\ldots)(\delta x(x'-a')\ldots)\varrho-\frac{1}{cc}\delta(\varrho(x'-a')^2\ldots)-\frac{2}{cc}(\varrho(x''-a'')\delta x\ldots)\Big]$
$-\frac{2}{cc}\delta(\partial_x(x'-a')\ldots)^2\varrho+\frac{4}{cc}\delta(\partial_x(x''-a'')\varrho\ldots)$
$v=[(x''+Ax')\delta x\ldots]+\frac{1}{\varrho}\delta P,\quad \frac{\partial\varrho x'}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial\varrho y'}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial\varrho z'}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial t}=0,\quad \varrho-\varrho_1=q$

$\partial_y^2+\partial_z^2=\partial_r^2+\frac{1}{r^2}\partial_\varphi^2+\frac{1}{r}\partial_r$
$\partial_y(y'-b')+\partial_z(z'-c')=\partial_r(r'-h')+\partial_\varphi(\varphi'-\eta')+\frac{1}{r}(r'-h')$
$(y'-b')\delta y+(z'-c')\delta z=(r'-h')\delta r+r^2(\varphi'-\eta')\delta\varphi$
$(y'-b')^2+(z'-c')^2=(r'-h')^2+r^2(\varphi'-\eta')^2$
$(y''-b'')\delta y+(z''-c'')\delta z=[r''-h''-r(\varphi'^2-\eta'^2)]\delta r+(2(r'\varphi'-h'\eta')+r\varphi''-r\eta'')\,r\,\delta\varphi$
$\partial_y^2(y'-b')^2+2\partial_y\partial_z(y'-b')(z'-c')+\partial_z^2(z'-c')^2=\partial_r^2(r'-h')^2+2\partial_r\partial_\varphi(r'-h')(\varphi'-\eta')+\partial_\varphi^2(\varphi'-\eta')^2+\frac{1}{r}\partial_r[(r'-h')^2-r^2(\varphi'-\eta')^2]+\frac{4}{r}\partial_\varphi(\varphi'-\eta')(r'-h')$
$\partial_y(y''-b'')+\partial_z(z''-c'')=(\partial_r+\frac{1}{r})(r''-h''-r(\varphi'^2-\eta'^2))+\frac{1}{r}\partial_\varphi(2(r'\varphi'-h'\eta')+r(\varphi''-\eta''))$

methods.what: Retarded-type potential integral expanded to order 1/c^2 in relative velocities and accelerations
Applying the Laplacian (Poisson equation) to the potential to obtain a local expression
